children: NextTrip announced a new at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $6.5 million through Titan Partners Securities, providing the company with flexible, on-demand access to capital under its effective Form S-3 shelf. Titan will sell shares from time to time, including on the Nasdaq Capital Market, for a 3.5% commission on gross proceeds. To facilitate the program, NextTrip obtained an exclusivity waiver from Craft Capital Management under a prior engagement and agreed to pay a 2.0% fee on gross proceeds from each ATM sale for nine months starting August 31, 2026. The moves are intended to enhance liquidity while preserving operational flexibility.
